notes:
Initial inbound from marketing promo. Small ecom platform (50-200 employees) building in-app chat + product search. Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) that won't surface 429s during predictable traffic spikes (campaign launches, cart abandonment messages). Current setup: single API key, baseline 40-60 req/min, peak observed 700+ concurrent requests for 10-15 minutes during last promo — many 429s reported by frontend; client used naive retry loops and saw degraded UX. They are cost-sensitive but willing to pay for predictable burst capacity that avoids customer-facing errors. Key quotes: "We'd rather pause non-critical jobs than see customers hit 429s during checkout" and "Can you give us a simple per-key concurrency and burst policy we can show engineering?".

Technical asks and acceptance criteria:
- Per-API-key soft quota with burst credits that amortize across short spikes (10-30m).
- Clear Retry-After headers and documented best-practice backoff pattern; sample client snippet requested.
- Optional short-lived elevated concurrency window for campaign launches (one-click enable in Console or API).
- Observability: per-key 429 counts, P50/P95 latency by route, peak concurrency chart for last 30 days.
- Cost: want guardrails to avoid runaway token costs during spikes (alerting + caps).

POC plan (agreed on call): SE runs replayed traffic (from sample logs) against hosted API under two configurations: default quota and proposed burst policy. Goal: <1% 429s during a 10-minute 3x spike and median completion latency <500ms for chat completions. If POC passes, move to 7-day trial with burst window enabled and finalize pricing.

Notes from call: CISO will need a short security checklist confirming no customer data retention >90 days and KMS options for keys if we proceed to Dedicated later. AE to send drive deck (pricing + burst policy examples) and example client backoff snippets.
